concerns.text: Task T008a hardcodes a static dictionary of 25 species and their guilds. This violates FR-001 and US-1 which mandate 'dynamic extraction of top-ranked species by total record count'. Hardcoding bypasses the statistical selection rule, effectively weakening the requirement to a static lookup.

Task T061 explicitly refactors the model to 'LogisticRegression' to replace the 'RandomForestClassifier' mandated by FR-004. While the Plan notes this as a 'Spec Gap', the task itself executes a requirement weakening (changing the core algorithm) without a formal spec amendment or explicit 'staged' flag in the task description.

Task T060 mandates downloading 'NLCD 2021' via HuggingFace, directly violating Constitution Principle VI and FR-002 which require 'NLCD 2019' from 'USGS EarthExplorer'. The task executes a silent constitution drift by swapping the mandated data source without a documented exception in the task's verification step.

Tasks T059 and T062 implement an 'Across-Species Permutation' (shuffling labels between species) instead of the 'stratified by species' test mandated by FR-005. The tasks justify this as 'impossible' for static guilds, but this constitutes a semantic weakening of the statistical methodology defined in the spec without a formal amendment.

Task T028.0 fetches literature predictors from a specific GitHub URL (`birds-of-the-world/habitat-guilds`) not cited in the Spec (which references 'Birds of the World' generally). This introduces a silent drift in the data source for the validity check (SC-003), risking the use of unverified data.
